changelog:
Version 8.3.2

Improved

* A clearer settings page: a sticky index groups the tools by job (alt text, site fixes, bulk SEO, images), and each tool shows at a glance whether it changes your site and how to undo it.

* A more legible typeface, Atkinson Hyperlegible, included with the plugin (nothing is loaded from other sites).

* Buttons that wrap onto a second line keep their spacing, and two-column settings stack on phones.

Also in this update (8.3.0 and 8.3.1)

* A new Image Compression section replaces the old one: convert your whole media library to WebP and AVIF copies, recompress original JPEGs in place (same name and address, only when the difference cannot be seen, with a backup and one-click restore), and compress a list of image addresses.

* After each run you can check the result: four sample images with a before/after slider and a full per-file list with search, filters and a CSV download.

* What it makes keeps working after the plugin is uninstalled: smaller JPEGs are the files themselves, and WebP / AVIF copies are served by a standard .htaccess rule on Apache and LiteSpeed servers.

* Removed: the old options that renamed images to .webp, rewrote image addresses in the database or deleted originals. Files they already changed are not touched.

* "Recompress originals" now also makes original WebP files smaller in place - same name and address, only when the difference cannot be seen, with a backup and one-click restore. Choose JPEG and / or WebP and a minimum file size; smaller files are skipped without being opened.

* "Recompress in place" for a single WebP address now applies the same quality checks and leaves animated WebP files alone.

* The before / after list shows a single result at its normal size and very small files in bytes.
